title: Mill-Turn AI — Multi-Tasking Machine Intelligence

units.title: 16 Mill-Turn AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 MILLTURN-AI domains: millturn_transfer (spindle-to-spindle handoff), millturn_synchronization (spindle sync), millturn_caxis (C-axis milling/polar interpolation), millturn_yaxis (Y-axis off-center), millturn_baxis (B-axis tilted milling), millturn_subspindle (sub-spindle operations), millturn_live_tooling (live tool operations), millturn_cutoff (part cutoff/catch), millturn_tailstock (tailstock support), millturn_steady_rest (steady rest positioning), millturn_bar_feed (bar feeder integration), millturn_workholding (mill-turn fixturing), millturn_process_sequence (operation sequencing), millturn_cycle_optimization (cycle time), millturn_collision_zones (collision management), millturn_program_structure (Mazatrol/conversational)

summary: Complete mill-turn AI intelligence with 16 domains covering part transfer, spindle synchronization, C/Y/B-axis operations, sub-spindle, live tooling, cutoff, tailstock, steady rest, bar feeding, workholding, process sequencing, cycle optimization, collision zones, and program structure. Deep expertise from 7 PDFs and multi-tasking machine posts.
